correctness.rationale: The matched potential is continuous at the cutoff and has its above-threshold maximum at b=1-r, of height b^3/6-epsilon^2/2. This is positive exactly on the stated mortality interval. Only the first root A is reachable from the tail; at the double root the travel time diverges. The C1 monotone pulse follows by the two energy quadratures; their mass has the stated factor 2 sqrt(D). At fixed cutoff the mass is bounded away from zero at r=0 and diverges at r_c: U(b)-U(v)=(b-v)^2(b+2v)/6 gives a logarithmically divergent lower estimate on the core integral as A approaches b. Continuity and vanishing of r/M at both ends give attainment and at least two distinct subcritical pulses. On compact mortality intervals, rescaling the turning point and removing the simple square-root endpoint singularity give M/(2 epsilon sqrt(D)) -> 1/sqrt(r)+sqrt(r)/(1-r) uniformly. The scaled competition is bounded by r sqrt(r+2 epsilon/3)/2 from the tail and by r(1-r) from the peak-height and curvature bound, so no maximizing sequence escapes to r=0 or r=1. The limiting objective r^(3/2)(1-r)/2 has its unique maximum at 3/5, with value 3 sqrt(15)/125. Continuous ODE dependence up to the transverse cutoff crossing and tail initial-value dependence give the locally uniform matched profile; the two slopes agree at -sqrt(3/5). Independent bounded quadrature (Python 3, branches/73d7376f-3156-4edf-81bd-609344c9374f/independent_capacity_check.py) at D=1 from epsilon=0.08 to 0.01 gave sampled optima tending toward these constants (at 0.01: r about 0.589100 and epsilon kappa about 0.090795). This is corroboration, not a global certificate; frozen verify.py was inspected, not run. No finite-cutoff uniqueness or stability conclusion is needed.

value.rationale: The maximum permissible competition is a natural invariant of the stationary pulse family. The global sharp asymptotic determines a capacity scale and coefficient that fixed-competition or local fold information does not supply. It also distinguishes the maximizing, cutoff-scale localized shapes from the broader branch and pins down the mortality and profile for every maximizer, while leaving dynamics and stability open.
